thread:
Asha (PM): quick one — i've uploaded the Q4 company OKR draft for product. can everyone do a fast pass today? link to doc: https://redwood.docs/okrs/q4-draft

okrs-bot: Draft submitted by Asha (PM) — review requested. deadline: 5pm PT.

Elaine (VP Product): skimmed. high-level looks good. two asks: 1) explicit launch criteria for product-facing SLAs, 2) make the perf KRs measurable (p50/p95, RU cost).

Sanjay (Eng): noted. for 2x throughput we need changes to batching + ~2 extra A100-class nodes or equivalent. rough ETA 6w if we prioritize. risk: infra hire or reallocation.

Tom H. (GTM): customers are asking about latency improvement too — can we commit to a p50 improvement? if not, sales will ask for credits until we hit it.

Lina (Data): propose adding eval datasets and regression thresholds to the KR text — e.g., "no more than 2% degradation on core intent set". that makes rollbacks objective.

Marcus (CEO): agree with Lina. also revenue/probe KR needs to be aligned to GTM assumptions. we should avoid a binary pass/fail that blocks org if GTM backing is thin.

Asha (PM): proposal: keep the throughput 2x and cost/unit -30% as stated. set latency target to p50 -15% as a primary KR + two stretch KRs for p50 -25% (if infra capacity approved). include the eval/regression language Lina suggested. add launch criteria: CI eval pass, 48h perf SLO on dedicated perf cluster, documented rollback plan.

Elaine (VP Product): that compromise seems fine. can we make the launch criteria bulletized in the doc? makes signoff easier.

Sanjay (Eng): i'll draft a short spec and resource table (nodes, batching config, infra lead) by EOD. timeline snippet i'll include: ```week1: infra prep; week2: perf tuning + quantization pass; week3: canary in prod; week4: full rollout```

Tom H. (GTM): i'll write the customer communication language and the conditional credits clause. will sync with legal on wording.

Marcus (CEO): if Eng + GTM approve the rollout plan and timeline i'm comfortable ratifying. can we confirm by 5pm PT today?

Asha (PM): yes — i'll collect approvals. please react with :thumbsup: when you agree to the compromise and timeline. @Elaine @Sanjay @Tom H.

Elaine (VP Product): :thumbsup:

Sanjay (Eng): :thumbsup:

Tom H. (GTM): :thumbsup:

okrs-bot: All required reviewers approved. Thread status: ratified by consensus. moved to "ratified" queue.

Asha (PM): thanks all — i'll update the draft with the bullets, timeline, and signatures and send the final doc to execs. if anything urgent, ping me in DMs.
